name: create_location
description: Create a new location and return its ID. Reuse an existing location ID when referring to an already established location.

parent_id.description: Parent location ID. Use null for a new root location.

type.description: General location category. Does not constrain parent-child relationships.

description.description: Short narrative description of the location.

subtype.description: Optional existing subtype ID, such as tavern or wizard tower. Look up subtype IDs using the available tools. Do not invent IDs or create overly specific subtypes solely for classification.

details.description: Additional established facts about the location as key-value pairs.
